remarks: Experience the charm of living in one of East Norwalk's most desirable locations. This stunning home offers breathtaking water views from nearly every room, set directly on the picturesque Mill Pond at East Norwalk Harbor. Step outside to the expansive deck, perfect for both relaxation and entertaining, with ample space for dining and lounging. The main level boasts a spacious living area with room for a dining table, and the kitchen is equipped with brand-new, high-end stainless steel appliances. A versatile bonus room on the main level can be used as a formal dining room, family room, or office, depending on your needs. Upstairs, the primary bedroom offers serene water views, complemented by two large closets and an en-suite bath featuring a tub, separate shower, and double vanities. There are also two additional bedrooms and another full bathroom on this level. This home is conveniently located within walking distance of East Norwalk's top attractions, including restaurants, shopping, the Metro North station, and SONO. Utilities included with the exception of cable and internet.
